description: This file defines GraphQL resolvers for project management, including queries and mutations such as fetching projects, creating, updating, and archiving projects, with access control via role checking.

methods.name: projects
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects associated with the user's company, enforcing user authentication.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific project by ID, ensuring user authentication.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new project with given title and optional description, requires 'admin' or 'member' role.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Updates project fields such as title, description, status for a given project ID, with role-based access control.

methods.name: archiveProject
methods.description: Changes the status of a project to 'archived', restricted to users with 'admin' role.
